messages:
Ana Gomez: Quick sync — we need a compact newsletter + webinar nurture for next product benchmark launch. Goal: drive webinar signups and surface benchmark report downloads. Thinking 3-email nurture (invite, reminder, last-chance) + 2 followups (record + benchmark highlights). Who wants to own segmentation and subject-line tests?
Liam O'Connor: I can own segmentation. Proposal: 3 cohorts — Existing paying customers (high-touch), free-trial users (mid), cold newsletter-only (low). Different send windows & CTAs.
Rachel Park: Subject-line ideas and test plan: A/B test personalization vs urgency. Examples: "[First name], join our live benchmark walkthrough" vs "Benchmark results: how inference costs compare (webinar)". Run 25/75 split for subject lines, measure opens -> registrations.
Marc Chen: ESP constraints: our ESP can only do 2 subject-line variants per send for same campaign unless we create multiple sends. Also watch DKIM/DMARC alignment for new subdomain. Suppression lists: exclude anyone who opened benchmark PDF in last 30 days and anyone who unsubscribed from product emails.
Ana Gomez: Good call on suppression. Liam — can you share the segment filters? Keep them small enough for reliable delivery.
Liam O'Connor: Segment filters (CSV-friendly):
```
segment_high_touch: tag:customer AND last_seen_30d:true AND plan:paid
segment_trial: tag:trial AND last_activity_14d:gte
segment_newsletter: opt_in:newsletter AND NOT tag:customer AND engagement_90d:low
```
Liam O'Connor: Send windows suggestion: customers -> Tue 10amPT, trial -> Wed 11amPT, newsletter -> Thu 8amPT (APAC-friendly).
Rachel Park: Email cadence copy brief: Invite (value + CTA), Reminder (agenda + speakers), Last-chance (social proof + urgency). Followups: 1) recording + TL;DR 2) benchmark highlights + CTA to download full report. Also include 3 UTM params: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch, utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email.
Marc Chen: QA checklist: seed list to include support, product, three test inboxes (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail), check images load with our CDN, verify personalization tokens, test unsubscribe link, check tracking pixels. Also confirm bounce rate projection for newsletter cohort.
Ana Gomez: Ops Bot — can you create the campaign draft and add tasks for QA & approvals? Tagging @Liam, @Rachel, @Marc for action items.
Ops Bot: Campaign draft created: "Benchmark Launch — Newsletter + Webinar Nurture". Tasks added: Segmentation (Liam), Subject-line tests (Rachel), ESP QA (Marc). Due: 3 days before send.
Rachel Park: For the A/B test holding rules — let's only send variant B to users who haven't opened variant A within 48 hours, otherwise keep them in A. That reduces cross-contamination.
Liam O'Connor: Notes on personalization: only use first-name token for customers and trialers. For newsletter cohort use non-personalized subject to avoid token failures.
Marc Chen: Leaving a note: double-check the SMTP sending domain throttle for Thu morning — might need to move newsletter earlier or split into two batches.
Ana Gomez: Great. I'll draft the short copy for invite and reminder and drop it in the campaign doc by EOD. Once QA passes, we'll schedule sends. :thumbsup:
